description: React component for a modal to forward a post in Mattermost, including channel selection, comment input, and message preview.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: No-operation function used as default callback.

methods.name: handlePostError
methods.description: Handles errors during post forwarding, sets error state and triggers animation.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the forwarding process, including channel permission checks, dispatching actions, and error handling.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Hides the modal, calls onExited callback if provided.

methods.name: handleChannelSelect
methods.description: Updates selected channel state based on user selection.

methods.name: preventActionOnPreview
methods.description: Prevents default click actions on the message preview.
